video_provenance.title: File:Aerial Views of Goddard- Integration and Test Facilities (SVS14443).webm
video_provenance.author: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio / Francis Reddy, Desiree Stover, Katherine Mellos, Cecelia Vitale-Reddy

domain_shift_and_limitations_disclosure.honest_assessment: Zero-shot oblique real NASA Goddard drone orbit over large white industrial rooftops, vertical concrete building facades, parked vehicles, and deciduous trees. Two honest cross-view domain-shift behaviors are observed and preserved raw without suppression: (1) PIDNet-S v2.1 segments flat rooftops, dark structural trim, parking lots, and trees consistently, while bright white vertical building facades under oblique sunlight partially trigger Safe_Flat_Roof/Safe_Flat_Ground in 2D RGB (motivating VertiRTA's surface-normal tilt and metric depth/LiDAR fusion before final touchdown); (2) M-LSD-WireSeg and D-FINE-N were trained on synthetic forward-facing sky/horizon obstacle corpora, so their detections on downward-oblique roofline seams and vertical building edges represent cross-view false positives that conservatively engage the CBVF 15.0 m/s caution speed clamp.
